latin: hwdwli barswl . nas tdhm ristwrwn iftrwa 9bl ma irw7wa ib7rwa w ana n9i btata , shwi flfla . fl9i dla3 . hadi m3isha 7sbi allh w n3m alwkil fikm .
english: ‘hwdwli barswl’ is kept source-close, but the utterance directly says: people eat restaurant food before they go to the sea; I clean potatoes and a little pepper; I found a watermelon; this is a life for which I seek God’s help and entrustment. The surface ‘7sbi allh w n3m alwkil fikm’ remains in the utterance. Canonical surface: `hwdwli barswl . nas tdhm ristwrwn iftrwa 9bl ma irw7wa ib7rwa w ana n9i btata , shwi flfla . fl9i dla3 . hadi m3isha 7sbi allh w n3m alwkil fikm .`.
korean: ‘hwdwli barswl’은 원문에 가깝게 두되 발화는 직접 번역해요. 사람들은 바다에 가기 전에 식당 음식을 먹고, 나는 감자와 약간의 피망을 손질하고, 수박을 찾았으며, 이런 삶에 대해 신의 도움과 맡김을 구한다고 해요. ‘7sbi allh w n3m alwkil fikm’ 표면도 발화 안에 보존해요. canonical 표면: `hwdwli barswl . nas tdhm ristwrwn iftrwa 9bl ma irw7wa ib7rwa w ana n9i btata , shwi flfla . fl9i dla3 . hadi m3isha 7sbi allh w n3m alwkil fikm .`.

latin: kifah hadi mnrw7sh llb7r rak 3a9d 3lia ana rai7a rai7a ktlni 7man w drb rask m3 al7it .
english: The speaker says ‘rak 3a9d 3lia’—you are holding me back or tying me down—then says ‘I am going, going’; ‘ktlni 7man’ is kept as ‘the heat is killing me’ before ‘hit your head against the wall’. Canonical surface: `kifah hadi mnrw7sh llb7r rak 3a9d 3lia ana rai7a rai7a ktlni 7man w drb rask m3 al7it .`.
korean: 화자는 ‘rak 3a9d 3lia’(네가 나를 막고 있거나 옭아매고 있어)라고 하고 ‘나는 가, 가’라고 해요. ‘ktlni 7man’은 ‘더위가 나를 죽이겠어’로 보존한 뒤 ‘머리를 벽에 부딪혀’라고 해요. canonical 표면: `kifah hadi mnrw7sh llb7r rak 3a9d 3lia ana rai7a rai7a ktlni 7man w drb rask m3 al7it .`.

latin: hdik li zl mdabza m3 altaksiat .
english: The speaker refers to the woman who is still arguing with the taxis; the exact scene is kept source-close.
korean: 화자는 아직도 택시들과 다투고 있는 여성을 말해요. 정확한 장면은 원문에 가깝게 보존해요.

latin: ana kwn sa3ftni kwn zdt b3dt rana nl3bwa 7wiza .
english: The speaker says that if the listener had helped them, they would have gone farther, and mentions playing the opaque game or activity ‘hwayza’.
korean: 화자는 상대가 도와줬다면 더 멀리 갔을 거라고 말하고, 불투명한 놀이 또는 활동인 ‘hwayza’를 언급해요.

latin: nkmlha abii khir li . win raki rai7a khti ? rani rai7a lldar . 9zan ana win n3rf darkm .
english: The speaker says finishing it would be better, asks where the sister is going, hears that she is going home, and says they do not know the family’s house; the opening surface is opaque.
korean: 화자는 그것을 끝내는 편이 낫다고 말하고 누이가 어디로 가는지 물어요. 누이가 집에 간다고 하자 그 집을 모른다고 말하며, 초두 표면은 불투명하게 보존해요.

latin: la kwlni khwia . rah iz9i 3lia rajli hada .
english: The speaker says directly, ‘Do not eat me, brother,’ and says that this husband is shouting at the speaker. The husband’s shouting direction is kept without inventing jealousy. Canonical surface: `la kwlni khwia . rah iz9i 3lia rajli hada .`.
korean: 화자는 직접 ‘나를 먹지 마, 형제야’라고 하고 이 남편이 화자에게 소리친다고 해요. 남편이 고함치는 방향을 보존하며 질투를 창작하지 않아요. canonical 표면: `la kwlni khwia . rah iz9i 3lia rajli hada .`.

latin: 7tni 3nd dar aldw . zid 9wli ma t3rfsh dar dw nta brw7k bain bli mashi wld blad .
english: The speaker asks to be left at Dar Dou and teases the listener for not knowing Dar Dou, saying that this shows the listener is not from the area.
korean: 화자는 다르 두에 내려 달라고 하며 상대가 다르 두를 모른다고 놀리고, 그것을 보니 상대가 이 지역 출신이 아니라고 말해요.

latin: astghr allh . 3lah rak tkhshsh bia khwia ? fwt 3la tri9 kbira kima ghashi . i3shi shal9 bia wak ntwma ma fikwmsh laman bndam wla ikhaf 3la rw7h . win raki rai7a khti ? la khwia ma tl3 m3aia 7ta w7da almrd rah ma khsnash t9r9ish . diri baft ta3k w sahl .
english: The speaker says ‘Astaghfirullah’, asks why the listener is dragging them around, tells them to take a main road, and complains that people have no safety. A second exchange asks where the sister is going, rejects the idea that a woman came along, mentions illness, and ends with an opaque instruction about a ‘baft’.
korean: 화자는 ‘아스타그피룰라’라고 말하고 왜 자신을 끌고 다니느냐고 물으며 큰길로 가라고 해요. 사람들이 안전하지 않다고 불평한 뒤, 누이가 어디로 가는지 묻고 여성이 함께 오지 않았다고 하며 아픈 상황을 말하고 불투명한 ‘baft’ 지시로 끝나요.

latin: raha fw9 rask khti . maknsh alli insa m3akm saii 7tni ghir hna . hak . allh ikhlf w alf ki sralha . alh i7fz w istr t3lmtwa ts9rwa 3la alsrf . tdiha alkhla w aldra .
english: The speaker says the matter is over the sister’s head, asks to be left there, gives thanks, invokes protection, and jokes that the others have learned to bargain over money before taking it to the countryside; several surfaces are opaque.
korean: 화자는 일이 누이의 머리 위에 있다고 말하고 그곳에 내려 달라고 해요. 감사와 보호를 말한 뒤 사람들이 돈을 흥정하는 법을 배웠다고 농담하고 그것을 시골로 가져간다고 해요. 여러 표면은 불투명해요.

latin: ki tdkhli ll7bs m3 s7btk .
english: The line refers to entering prison with a friend; it is an incomplete, context-dependent remark.
korean: 친구와 함께 감옥에 들어가는 상황을 말하는 불완전하고 맥락 의존적인 발화예요.

latin: ma nsm3sh 7skm . j3t kwn ghir ma tjibli mbss fl9fa . tfwa mrhwja 3la jalk basit mn nhar alli 3rftk ma sht khir . iak ia d7s jbdtlk bwsb3a w 9ltlk 9isih m3aia flwad bsif nti brw7k knti ghir 3la sba ghi 3ittlk jiti tjri .
english: The speaker says ‘I cannot hear your voices’, says they are hungry and asks for the opaque food surface ‘mbss’ in a bag, then says ‘you have been no good since the day I knew you’ and keeps the final sequence in which the speaker called and the addressee came running. The complaint and its cause are direct utterance content. Canonical surface: `ma nsm3sh 7skm . j3t kwn ghir ma tjibli mbss fl9fa . tfwa mrhwja 3la jalk basit mn nhar alli 3rftk ma sht khir . iak ia d7s jbdtlk bwsb3a w 9ltlk 9isih m3aia flwad bsif nti brw7k knti ghir 3la sba ghi 3ittlk jiti tjri .`.
korean: 화자는 ‘너희 목소리가 안 들려’라고 하고 배가 고프다며 봉지에 든 불투명한 음식 표면 ‘mbss’를 달라고 해요. 이어 ‘너를 안 날부터 너는 좋은 일을 한 적이 없어’라고 하고, 화자가 불러서 상대가 달려온 마지막 sequence도 직접 발화로 보존해요. canonical 표면: `ma nsm3sh 7skm . j3t kwn ghir ma tjibli mbss fl9fa . tfwa mrhwja 3la jalk basit mn nhar alli 3rftk ma sht khir . iak ia d7s jbdtlk bwsb3a w 9ltlk 9isih m3aia flwad bsif nti brw7k knti ghir 3la sba ghi 3ittlk jiti tjri .`.

latin: bl3i bl3i fmk nti brw7k 7rkia kwn ma zfitinish 3nd jij kwn ma ranish hna . nti ktltih w ana r7t fi jra w mashi ana alli ktlth ana ki 3awntk t9isih flwad kan m9ndl .
english: The speaker directly insults the addressee in ‘nti brw7k 7rkia’, says ‘you killed him’, then ‘I went in a mess’, and ‘I was not the one who killed him’. The opaque surfaces ‘jra’ and ‘m9ndl’ remain unresolved, but the actor contrast is translated. Canonical surface: `bl3i bl3i fmk nti brw7k 7rkia kwn ma zfitinish 3nd jij kwn ma ranish hna . nti ktltih w ana r7t fi jra w mashi ana alli ktlth ana ki 3awntk t9isih flwad kan m9ndl .`.
korean: 화자는 ‘nti brw7k 7rkia’로 상대를 직접 모욕하고 ‘네가 그를 죽였어’, ‘나는 엉켜서 갔어’, ‘그를 죽인 건 내가 아니야’라고 해요. ‘jra’와 ‘m9ndl’은 불투명하게 두되 행위자 대비는 직접 번역해요. canonical 표면: `bl3i bl3i fmk nti brw7k 7rkia kwn ma zfitinish 3nd jij kwn ma ranish hna . nti ktltih w ana r7t fi jra w mashi ana alli ktlth ana ki 3awntk t9isih flwad kan m9ndl .`.

latin: baghi ndkhl w7di awmwan ntraf9wa w twnsini shwia . ia 7ti twnsi w7dk 7asbtni mtlw9a kifk wa9il ana ada ma ktlwnish fl7bs iktlni khwia nhar alli ikhrj .
english: The speaker wants to enter alone but asks for company and a little entertainment. ‘awmwan’ is ‘at least’, and ‘7asbtni mtlw9a kifk wa9il’ keeps the direction ‘did you think I was a released/free woman like you?’ without forcing a single legal status. Canonical surface: `baghi ndkhl w7di awmwan ntraf9wa w twnsini shwia . ia 7ti twnsi w7dk 7asbtni mtlw9a kifk wa9il ana ada ma ktlwnish fl7bs iktlni khwia nhar alli ikhrj .`.
korean: 화자는 혼자 들어가고 싶지만 함께 있어 주고 조금 즐겁게 해 달라고 해요. ‘awmwan’은 ‘적어도’로, ‘7asbtni mtlw9a kifk wa9il’은 ‘나도 너처럼 풀려난/자유로운 여자라고 생각했어?’라는 방향으로 보존하되 법적 상태를 하나로 고정하지 않아요. canonical 표면: `baghi ndkhl w7di awmwan ntraf9wa w twnsini shwia . ia 7ti twnsi w7dk 7asbtni mtlw9a kifk wa9il ana ada ma ktlwnish fl7bs iktlni khwia nhar alli ikhrj .`.

latin: aai ntwma bl3wh rakm hna fi zwj d9ai9 djjtwna . aai akhti w allh ala ghaia arwa7i khitili fmi ma ndabzsh m3 s7bti .
english: The speaker says the listeners exhausted them in two minutes, calls to the sister, and asks her to stitch or close the speaker’s mouth so the speaker will not fight with the friend; the surface is partly opaque.
korean: 화자는 일행이 2분 만에 자신을 지치게 했다고 하고 누이를 부르며, 친구와 다투지 않도록 자신의 입을 꿰매거나 닫아 달라고 해요. 일부 표면은 불투명해요.

latin: aai 3labalk win raki hnaia . tiri 3liha mwjilali . arwa7i tiri 3lia mwljilali . alli bgha dm , i9dm mzia jit , awmbiws shaba rahi hna mn alsh3r .
english: The speaker asks, ‘Do you know where you are now?’; keeps the opaque name-like ‘mwjilali/mwljilali’; says whoever wants blood should come; says ‘I came well/right’ in ‘mzia jit’; and keeps the praise-like ‘awmbiws shaba rahi hna mn alsh3r’ source-close. Canonical surface: `aai 3labalk win raki hnaia . tiri 3liha mwjilali . arwa7i tiri 3lia mwljilali . alli bgha dm , i9dm mzia jit , awmbiws shaba rahi hna mn alsh3r .`.
korean: 화자는 ‘네가 지금 어디 있는지 알아?’라고 묻고 불투명한 이름 같은 ‘mwjilali/mwljilali’를 보존해요. 피를 원하는 사람은 오라고 하고 ‘mzia jit’은 ‘내가 오길 잘했어/잘 왔어’ 방향으로 번역하며 ‘awmbiws shaba rahi hna mn alsh3r’는 원문에 가깝게 둬요. canonical 표면: `aai 3labalk win raki hnaia . tiri 3liha mwjilali . arwa7i tiri 3lia mwljilali . alli bgha dm , i9dm mzia jit , awmbiws shaba rahi hna mn alsh3r .`.

latin: hadik li tkhdm fi lamiri ki tdkhl ldarha .
english: The speaker describes the woman who works at the town hall when she enters her home; it is a short incomplete comparison.
korean: 화자가 시청에서 일하는 여성이 집에 들어갈 때를 묘사하는 짧고 불완전한 비교예요.

latin: mama 3ndki . ma ti7lish w 7mar . aai asm3wa rasi rah baghi itrt9 . wlwa mnb3d khima nsr3 wa7d fikm .
english: The speaker warns the mother not to fall and calls someone a donkey, says their head is about to burst, and threatens to knock one of them out later; the comic threats are retained without literal escalation.
korean: 화자는 엄마에게 넘어지지 말라고 하고 누군가를 당나귀라고 부르며 머리가 터질 것 같다고 해요. 나중에 일행 중 한 명을 쓰러뜨리겠다고 농담해요.

latin: mama n9d nrw7 m3 aimn lstad . m3lblish , shwf m3 shaf srfis rani nt9hwa . m3 mn ? m3 bwk .
english: The speaker says ‘I don’t know’; tells the listener to check with the service chief; says ‘I am drinking coffee’; then keeps the separate question ‘with whom?’ and answer ‘with your father’. Canonical surface: `mama n9d nrw7 m3 aimn lstad . m3lblish , shwf m3 shaf srfis rani nt9hwa . m3 mn ? m3 bwk .`.
korean: 화자는 ‘모르겠어’라고 하고 상대에게 서비스 책임자에게 확인하라고 해요. ‘나는 커피를 마시는 중이야’라고 한 뒤 별도의 ‘누구와?’와 ‘네 아버지와’라는 Q/A를 보존해요. canonical 표면: `mama n9d nrw7 m3 aimn lstad . m3lblish , shwf m3 shaf srfis rani nt9hwa . m3 mn ? m3 bwk .`.

latin: ma nti 9a3 3am mshnfa , mt aimn 3ndha al79 9altli mk mn 3am da9iws ma d7ktsh .
english: The speaker says the listener has been sulky all year; says ‘Aymen’s mother is right’; and reports ‘your mother told me that you have not laughed ...’. The explicit ‘mk’/your-mother surface is retained and the reported relation is not merged with Aymen’s mother. Canonical surface: `ma nti 9a3 3am mshnfa , mt aimn 3ndha al79 9altli mk mn 3am da9iws ma d7ktsh .`.
korean: 화자는 상대가 1년 내내 시무룩하다고 하고 ‘아이만의 어머니가 맞아’라고 해요. 이어 ‘네 어머니가 네가 ... 웃지 않았다고 내게 말했어’라는 전언을 보존해요. 명시적인 ‘mk’/네 어머니 표면을 살리고 아이만의 어머니와 합치지 않아요. canonical 표면: `ma nti 9a3 3am mshnfa , mt aimn 3ndha al79 9altli mk mn 3am da9iws ma d7ktsh .`.

latin: 9wlha rw7i 3si rajlk alli ja 39d 3la zawja liwm ia shtba . jaia t3sni anaia .
english: The speaker tells someone to go watch the husband who came today to propose marriage, then jokes that the woman has come to watch the speaker instead.
korean: 화자는 오늘 청혼하러 온 남편을 지켜보러 가라고 하고, 그 여성이 오히려 자신을 지켜보러 왔다고 농담해요.

latin: t7zn 3lia ma tzid thdr nwrilha .
english: The speaker says ‘feel sorry for me’, ‘do not talk any more’, and ‘I will show her’. The object of ‘show her’ is left open; no event is invented. Canonical surface: `t7zn 3lia ma tzid thdr nwrilha .`.
korean: 화자는 ‘나를 불쌍히 여겨’, ‘더 말하지 마’, ‘내가 그녀에게 보여 줄게’라고 해요. ‘보여 주다’의 내용은 열어 두고 어떤 사건도 발명하지 않아요. canonical 표면: `t7zn 3lia ma tzid thdr nwrilha .`.

latin: ma dirinash 3sha ntia . kikwta ma rahsh tkhdm khwia , ma ndirsh , rani kwnji , wla rw7 3nd sba7 alkhir jarti ki sb7ti ? dirlk 3sha , wli ghdwa .
english: The speaker asks or tells the female addressee about dinner, keeps the greeting ‘good morning, my neighbour; how did you wake up?’, and says ‘make yourself dinner; come back tomorrow’. ‘wli ghdwa’ is not changed into ‘leave dinner for tomorrow’. Canonical surface: `ma dirinash 3sha ntia . kikwta ma rahsh tkhdm khwia , ma ndirsh , rani kwnji , wla rw7 3nd sba7 alkhir jarti ki sb7ti ? dirlk 3sha , wli ghdwa .`.
korean: 화자는 여성 청자에게 저녁을 묻거나 요구하고 ‘좋은 아침, 이웃아. 잘 잤어?’라는 인사를 보존해요. ‘저녁을 만들어 먹고 내일 다시 와’라고 하며 ‘wli ghdwa’를 ‘내일 먹도록 남겨 둬’로 바꾸지 않아요. canonical 표면: `ma dirinash 3sha ntia . kikwta ma rahsh tkhdm khwia , ma ndirsh , rani kwnji , wla rw7 3nd sba7 alkhir jarti ki sb7ti ? dirlk 3sha , wli ghdwa .`.

latin: anwa3 alshirat fi lafak hadik alli jaia dbr rajl bash ttzwj .
english: The speaker mentions types of girls in ‘lafak’, including the one who comes to find a husband in order to marry; the place or surface name is kept source-close.
korean: 화자는 ‘lafak’에 있는 여자들의 유형을 말하며, 결혼할 남편을 찾으러 오는 여성을 언급해요. 장소나 표면 이름은 원문에 가깝게 보존해요.

latin: slam khwia . win idsrwa lizaskrbsiwn 7mbwk ? awfas . s7a .
english: The speaker greets the brother and asks where the registrations are done, receiving an opaque place-name answer; the greeting exchange is preserved.
korean: 화자는 형제에게 인사하고 등록을 어디에서 하는지 묻으며 불투명한 장소 이름의 답을 들어요. 인사 turn을 보존해요.

latin: baghi ns9sik rjal win ijm3wa ? sl3a jhd bs7 mashi bti . win ijm3wa ?
english: The speaker asks where the men gather, says the goods are strong but not cheap, and repeats the question about where they gather; the market vocabulary is source-close.
korean: 화자는 남자들이 어디에 모이는지 묻고 물건이 튼튼하지만 싸지는 않다고 말한 뒤 어디에 모이는지 다시 물어요. 시장 어휘는 원문에 가깝게 보존해요.

latin: almkrasha : sha bghit n9wlk nrw7wa 3shia 3nd mstfa nftrwa , bs7 raha 3ad 8 .
english: Keeping only the opaque title-like ‘almkrasha’, the speaker directly proposes: ‘Let us go this evening to Mustafa’s place and eat/break the fast’; the meal/iftar surface ‘nftrwa’ is not normalized as breakfast. Canonical surface: `almkrasha : sha bghit n9wlk nrw7wa 3shia 3nd mstfa nftrwa , bs7 raha 3ad 8 .`.
korean: 불투명한 제목 같은 ‘almkrasha’만 원문에 가깝게 두고, 화자는 직접 ‘오늘 저녁 무스타파에게 가서 먹자/금식을 깨자’고 제안해요. 식사·이프타르 표면 ‘nftrwa’를 아침 식사로 특정하지 않아요. canonical 표면: `almkrasha : sha bghit n9wlk nrw7wa 3shia 3nd mstfa nftrwa , bs7 raha 3ad 8 .`.

latin: wah khti j3t ma 9ditsh rkz w ana krshi khawia allh i7fz w istr sha tbl3 .
english: The speaker directly invokes protection—‘may God protect and shelter/keep us’—and asks ‘what is there to eat/swallow?’ in ‘sha tbl3’. Canonical surface: `wah khti j3t ma 9ditsh rkz w ana krshi khawia allh i7fz w istr sha tbl3 .`.
korean: 화자는 ‘신이 보호하고 지켜 주시길’이라고 직접 축원하고 ‘뭘 먹어/삼켜?’라고 ‘sha tbl3’로 물어요. canonical 표면: `wah khti j3t ma 9ditsh rkz w ana krshi khawia allh i7fz w istr sha tbl3 .`.

latin: li 3la 3am w hi mdabza m3 sa7bha , ia m3ad tl9ni 7mbwk w allh hw hdr m3aia ana sha dkhlni , 3ndk ghadi tzr9ni . tl9ni 7mbwk . ki dair ghiar .
english: The speaker keeps the vocative ‘ia m3ad’, the repeated ‘tl9ni 7mbwk’, the line about what the speaker has to do, and the closing ‘ki dair ghiar’ as ‘how jealous he/she is’ or ‘the jealousy is something else’. The jealousy direction is not reduced to fear of being hit. Canonical surface: `li 3la 3am w hi mdabza m3 sa7bha , ia m3ad tl9ni 7mbwk w allh hw hdr m3aia ana sha dkhlni , 3ndk ghadi tzr9ni . tl9ni 7mbwk . ki dair ghiar .`.
korean: 화자는 호칭 ‘ia m3ad’, 반복되는 ‘tl9ni 7mbwk’, 화자가 무슨 상관이냐고 하는 절, 마지막 ‘ki dair ghiar’를 ‘질투가 참 심하네/얼마나 질투하는지’ 방향으로 보존해요. 이를 맞을까 두렵다는 말로 줄이지 않아요. canonical 표면: `li 3la 3am w hi mdabza m3 sa7bha , ia m3ad tl9ni 7mbwk w allh hw hdr m3aia ana sha dkhlni , 3ndk ghadi tzr9ni . tl9ni 7mbwk . ki dair ghiar .`.

latin: li t9ra ghir alkwr lwl w tkhrj . astad . wi fm klb hdri brki ma t3wji fi rw7k . n9d nrw7 lisanitr ?
english: The line keeps the direct insult ‘fm klb’, the warning not to twist or harm oneself in ‘hdri brki ma t3wji fi rw7k’, and the direct question ‘can I go to the restroom/sanitary place?’ in ‘lisanitr’. Canonical surface: `li t9ra ghir alkwr lwl w tkhrj . astad . wi fm klb hdri brki ma t3wji fi rw7k . n9d nrw7 lisanitr ?`.
korean: 이 행은 직접 모욕 ‘fm klb’, ‘hdri brki ma t3wji fi rw7k’의 경고, ‘lisanitr’에 가도 되느냐는 화장실·위생 시설 질문을 직접 번역해요. canonical 표면: `li t9ra ghir alkwr lwl w tkhrj . astad . wi fm klb hdri brki ma t3wji fi rw7k . n9d nrw7 lisanitr ?`.

latin: li t9ra li lwn9 . fwzia sha raki daira liwm . m3labalish , rahm dairin lwbia . sha raki la3btha lna fwzia .
english: The speaker mentions someone who studies only the long course, asks Fouzia what she is doing today, hears that they are making beans, and asks what she is pretending to be for them.
korean: 화자는 긴 과정만 공부하는 사람을 언급하고 푸지아에게 오늘 무엇을 하는지 물어요. 콩을 만들고 있다는 답을 듣고 무엇인 척하는지 다시 물어요.

latin: kwn jaw alshirat fi blasa ma ikdbwa i9wlwa als7 . shrit hadi tani iadra .
english: The speaker says that if the girls were in the place of the ones who lie, they would tell the truth, and says they bought this one too; the comparison is opaque.
korean: 화자는 여자들이 거짓말하는 사람들의 자리에 있다면 진실을 말할 것이라고 하고 이것도 샀다고 말해요. 비교의 대상은 불투명해요.

latin: sh3al shritiha ? shritha mliwn w ma 9ash7thash . had shrmita w raki thdri 3liha . sha hadi ma nshrwsh , ma nlbswsh , ma nstahlwsh , ma shi bniadm 7na . baghi ndir sa7b ghir bd3wa alkhir .
english: The speaker directly calls it ‘that whore/bitch’ in the offensive surface ‘had shrmita’, says ‘we will not buy it, wear it, or deserve it’, says ‘we are not human’, and then wants to make a friend through a good-wish phrase. The abusive speech is not meta-described or softened. Canonical surface: `sh3al shritiha ? shritha mliwn w ma 9ash7thash . had shrmita w raki thdri 3liha . sha hadi ma nshrwsh , ma nlbswsh , ma nstahlwsh , ma shi bniadm 7na . baghi ndir sa7b ghir bd3wa alkhir .`.
korean: 화자는 공격적인 ‘had shrmita’를 직접 욕설로 말하고 ‘우리는 사지도 입지도 그럴 자격도 없어’, ‘우리는 인간도 아니야’라고 해요. 이어 좋은 말로 친구를 만들고 싶다고 하며 욕설을 메타 설명으로 순화하지 않아요. canonical 표면: `sh3al shritiha ? shritha mliwn w ma 9ash7thash . had shrmita w raki thdri 3liha . sha hadi ma nshrwsh , ma nlbswsh , ma nstahlwsh , ma shi bniadm 7na . baghi ndir sa7b ghir bd3wa alkhir .`.

latin: baba bs7 tinisa rak darbha kima t3 li knt nkhrj m3ah . shwala ? malk takl fi rw7k kmlna . z3ma 93d i3itli bash nwlwa bs7 saii si fini ma nkhdmsh 9lit . drwk ghir aibiza w tl3 .
english: ‘tinisa’ is kept as a tennis/sneakers-like surface rather than a created woman. ‘saii si fini’ is ‘enough, it’s finished’; the final Ibiza surface and the other job phrase remain source-close where needed. Canonical surface: `baba bs7 tinisa rak darbha kima t3 li knt nkhrj m3ah . shwala ? malk takl fi rw7k kmlna . z3ma 93d i3itli bash nwlwa bs7 saii si fini ma nkhdmsh 9lit . drwk ghir aibiza w tl3 .`.
korean: ‘tinisa’는 창작된 여성이 아니라 테니스화·운동화 같은 표면으로 보존해요. ‘saii si fini’는 ‘됐어, 끝났어’로 번역하고 마지막 이비자 표면과 다른 직업 표현은 필요한 만큼 원문에 가깝게 둬요. canonical 표면: `baba bs7 tinisa rak darbha kima t3 li knt nkhrj m3ah . shwala ? malk takl fi rw7k kmlna . z3ma 93d i3itli bash nwlwa bs7 saii si fini ma nkhdmsh 9lit . drwk ghir aibiza w tl3 .`.

latin: jinakm b7sb w nsb . al7sb w alnsb jibwh m3ah awmwa bwki t3 wrd . dija mbkrin li ana , nas tji tkhtb li 3la 10 t3 alsba7 ghadi nhrb . w nta mashi 9tlk lbs 9mja nhar alli tji tkhtbni .
english: The speaker says they came with lineage and asks for the lineage to be brought with a rose bouquet. They joke that people who come to propose at ten in the morning will make the speaker run, and remind the listener to wear a shirt when coming to propose.
korean: 화자는 혈통과 신분을 갖추고 왔다고 하며 장미 꽃다발과 함께 그 혈통을 가져오라고 해요. 오전 10시에 청혼하러 오는 사람들을 보면 도망가겠다고 농담하고 청혼하러 올 때 셔츠를 입으라고 상기시켜요.

latin: sha raki thdri t3rfih ? n3rfh wah , 5 snsn w ana taiba m3ah wjh almiziria hada .
english: The speaker asks whether the listener knows him, answers yes, and says they have been involved with him for five years, calling him a face of misery; the idiom is preserved as a joke.
korean: 화자는 상대가 그 남자를 아느냐고 묻고 안다고 답하며 5년 동안 그와 얽혀 있었다고 해요. 그를 불행의 얼굴이라고 부르는 표현은 농담으로 보존해요.

latin: dija hadi hi mk tban msfara ma nsknsh m3aha hadi , diri dari w7di n9wlha lk 9damha .
english: The speaker says ‘make/arrange a separate home for me’ in ‘diri dari w7di’, not ‘make your own home’, and says ‘I am telling you in front of her’ in ‘n9wlha lk 9damha’. Canonical surface: `dija hadi hi mk tban msfara ma nsknsh m3aha hadi , diri dari w7di n9wlha lk 9damha .`.
korean: 화자는 ‘diri dari w7di’로 ‘내가 따로 살 집을 마련해 줘/내 집을 따로 해 줘’라고 하지 ‘네 집을 만들어’라고 하지 않아요. ‘n9wlha lk 9damha’는 ‘그녀 앞에서 너에게 말하는 거야’로 보존해요. canonical 표면: `dija hadi hi mk tban msfara ma nsknsh m3aha hadi , diri dari w7di n9wlha lk 9damha .`.

latin: s7btk kwn jat kiasa t3 al7mam . 3lah raki tswri fia khti ? 3la mn raki ia fkrwna . shti kmartk . haila mraia ada ma zal ma shftish rw7k nkhli 9a3 3bad rbi w nji nswrk ntia . sha ndir bik 7mbwk .
english: The speaker teases with ‘fkrwna’ as a turtle, ‘kmartk’ as the face, ‘haila mraia’ as ‘what a mirror/that mirror’, says they will leave everyone and come photograph the listener, and asks ‘what shall I do with you?’ in ‘sha ndir bik’. Canonical surface: `s7btk kwn jat kiasa t3 al7mam . 3lah raki tswri fia khti ? 3la mn raki ia fkrwna . shti kmartk . haila mraia ada ma zal ma shftish rw7k nkhli 9a3 3bad rbi w nji nswrk ntia . sha ndir bik 7mbwk .`.
korean: 화자는 ‘fkrwna’를 거북이라고 놀리고 ‘kmartk’를 얼굴·낯으로 말해요. ‘haila mraia’를 거울에 관한 놀림으로 두고, 모두를 두고 와서 상대를 찍겠다고 하며 ‘sha ndir bik’으로 ‘너를 어떻게 해야 하지?’라고 반문해요. canonical 표면: `s7btk kwn jat kiasa t3 al7mam . 3lah raki tswri fia khti ? 3la mn raki ia fkrwna . shti kmartk . haila mraia ada ma zal ma shftish rw7k nkhli 9a3 3bad rbi w nji nswrk ntia . sha ndir bik 7mbwk .`.

latin: 3nddha 3lah tkhaf khti mrt khwia darwha fi 9rwb t3 alm3lmat almtl9at fi al7mam .
english: The utterance directly asks why the sister is afraid, says ‘my brother’s wife’, and says ‘they put her in the group’ with plural ‘darwha’. The initial ‘3nddha’ relation is not omitted and the sole actor is not invented. Canonical surface: `3nddha 3lah tkhaf khti mrt khwia darwha fi 9rwb t3 alm3lmat almtl9at fi al7mam .`.
korean: 발화는 누이가 왜 무서워하는지 직접 묻고 ‘내 형제의 아내’를 말하며 복수형 ‘darwha’로 ‘그들이 그녀를 그룹에 넣었다’고 해요. 초두 ‘3nddha’ 관계를 빠뜨리지 않고 유일한 행위자를 창작하지 않아요. canonical 표면: `3nddha 3lah tkhaf khti mrt khwia darwha fi 9rwb t3 alm3lmat almtl9at fi al7mam .`.

latin: w nti sha nt9k ? la arwa7wa t7amwa fia aia khti alli ma 3jbhash al7al trw7 dwsh fi darha .
english: The speaker asks what the other person is saying, invites everyone to bathe them, and says anyone who is unhappy can go shower at home.
korean: 화자는 상대가 무슨 말을 하는지 묻고 모두에게 자신을 씻겨 달라고 해요. 마음에 들지 않는 사람은 집에서 샤워하러 가라고 해요.

latin: khti hada ghir zhr sa3a w ana n7k fik frktk nti nkhls 3lik balmtr almrb3 . la khti kiasa lkhra tkhls 3lia ghir khmslaf . wi tl9wni ghadi ntrt9 fwta w ntir 3liha .
english: The speaker says the other hammam scrubber gets five thousand from the speaker in ‘kiasa lkhra tkhls 3lia ghir khmslaf’, and keeps ‘ntrt9 fwta w ntir 3liha’ as the direct comic threat/action rather than a meta-summary. Canonical surface: `khti hada ghir zhr sa3a w ana n7k fik frktk nti nkhls 3lik balmtr almrb3 . la khti kiasa lkhra tkhls 3lia ghir khmslaf . wi tl9wni ghadi ntrt9 fwta w ntir 3liha .`.
korean: 화자는 ‘kiasa lkhra tkhls 3lia ghir khmslaf’로 다른 목욕탕 때밀이가 자신에게 5천만 받는다고 직접 말해요. ‘ntrt9 fwta w ntir 3liha’도 메타 설명이 아니라 직접적인 코믹 위협·행동으로 보존해요. canonical 표면: `khti hada ghir zhr sa3a w ana n7k fik frktk nti nkhls 3lik balmtr almrb3 . la khti kiasa lkhra tkhls 3lia ghir khmslaf . wi tl9wni ghadi ntrt9 fwta w ntir 3liha .`.

latin: khmslaf rani ntlb 3lik khti . ghadi aldwd alli khrjth lk nwklh lk . rani n9wlk . khti hada raki mdkhlath m3ah . wah mskin wldi sghir hada . sha sghrh khti hada rah 3r3wr shlaghmh tktfi bihm jml .
english: The speaker asks for five thousand, says ‘I will feed you the worms I pulled out’, and keeps ‘3r3wr’ unresolved if needed while translating ‘shlaghmh’ toward moustache. The known worm and moustache surfaces are not both hidden as generic body imagery. Canonical surface: `khmslaf rani ntlb 3lik khti . ghadi aldwd alli khrjth lk nwklh lk . rani n9wlk . khti hada raki mdkhlath m3ah . wah mskin wldi sghir hada . sha sghrh khti hada rah 3r3wr shlaghmh tktfi bihm jml .`.
korean: 화자는 5천을 요구하고 ‘내가 꺼낸 벌레들을 너에게 먹일 거야’라고 해요. ‘3r3wr’는 필요하면 불확실하게 두되 ‘shlaghmh’는 콧수염 방향으로 번역해요. 아는 벌레·콧수염 표면을 모두 일반 신체 이미지로 숨기지 않아요. canonical 표면: `khmslaf rani ntlb 3lik khti . ghadi aldwd alli khrjth lk nwklh lk . rani n9wlk . khti hada raki mdkhlath m3ah . wah mskin wldi sghir hada . sha sghrh khti hada rah 3r3wr shlaghmh tktfi bihm jml .`.

latin: ghir i9r3lk hna khti hada ghtdi dkhlih li ihrbli 9a3 nsa t3 al7mam .
english: The speaker says ‘bring him inside’ with the masculine object, and says he will make all the women at the hammam run away in ‘ihrbli 9a3 nsa t3 al7mam’. The direction is a direct sentence, not a gender-switched summary. Canonical surface: `ghir i9r3lk hna khti hada ghtdi dkhlih li ihrbli 9a3 nsa t3 al7mam .`.
korean: 화자는 남성 목적어로 ‘그를 들여보내’라고 하고 ‘그가 목욕탕 여자들을 전부 도망가게 할 거야’라는 ‘ihrbli 9a3 nsa t3 al7mam’ 방향을 직접 번역해요. 성별을 바꾼 요약으로 만들지 않아요. canonical 표면: `ghir i9r3lk hna khti hada ghtdi dkhlih li ihrbli 9a3 nsa t3 al7mam .`.

latin: s7btk kwn jat awtas dw lagh : bwnjwgh . inwdwni drwk . hadwa irw7wa lfrnsa 3la 5 t3 sba7 ghadi thrb . ki sb7ti zhra . ki rak baghini nsb7 7mbwk . l79ni klb brhwsh sba7 ki khrjt ana njri w hw inb7 . khwia hada 3rajin t3 altmr 9a3 rak mtl3hm m3ak . kwn 9l3t alnkhl t3 awtwrwt w jlthm m3ak w saii ala ma rahmsh iwklwk fi frwnsa 93dwa fi bladkm .
english: The code-switch is kept as an air-hostess/‘bonjour’ greeting; ‘inwdwni drwk’ and ‘ki rak baghini nsb7’ are directly translated, and the closing says that if France will not feed them, they should stay in their own country. These are direct turns, not merely preserved surfaces. Canonical surface: `s7btk kwn jat awtas dw lagh : bwnjwgh . inwdwni drwk . hadwa irw7wa lfrnsa 3la 5 t3 sba7 ghadi thrb . ki sb7ti zhra . ki rak baghini nsb7 7mbwk . l79ni klb brhwsh sba7 ki khrjt ana njri w hw inb7 . khwia hada 3rajin t3 altmr 9a3 rak mtl3hm m3ak . kwn 9l3t alnkhl t3 awtwrwt w jlthm m3ak w saii ala ma rahmsh iwklwk fi frwnsa 93dwa fi bladkm .`.
korean: code-switch는 항공 승무원·‘bonjour’ 인사로 보존하고 ‘inwdwni drwk’와 ‘ki rak baghini nsb7’를 직접 번역해요. 마지막은 프랑스가 그들을 먹여 살리지 않으면 자기 나라에 남으라는 뜻으로 직접 보존해요. 단순히 표면을 보존한다는 메타 설명으로 대체하지 않아요. canonical 표면: `s7btk kwn jat awtas dw lagh : bwnjwgh . inwdwni drwk . hadwa irw7wa lfrnsa 3la 5 t3 sba7 ghadi thrb . ki sb7ti zhra . ki rak baghini nsb7 7mbwk . l79ni klb brhwsh sba7 ki khrjt ana njri w hw inb7 . khwia hada 3rajin t3 altmr 9a3 rak mtl3hm m3ak . kwn 9l3t alnkhl t3 awtwrwt w jlthm m3ak w saii ala ma rahmsh iwklwk fi frwnsa 93dwa fi bladkm .`.

latin: ia 3ndki hadi kiraha mshawjia baldhb 7ta zhrha 3waj . krim arwa7 hna . khwia raha 6 t3 sba7 shd krim ta3k , khima ndlih lk mn alta9a . wi alzin lakwb kari w nkhmm fik swnzari .
english: ‘lakwb kari’ is an angular or square haircut, a la coupe carrée surface; ‘swnzari’ is ‘continuously/without stopping’ toward sans arrêt. Neither known direction is left wholly opaque. Canonical surface: `ia 3ndki hadi kiraha mshawjia baldhb 7ta zhrha 3waj . krim arwa7 hna . khwia raha 6 t3 sba7 shd krim ta3k , khima ndlih lk mn alta9a . wi alzin lakwb kari w nkhmm fik swnzari .`.
korean: ‘lakwb kari’는 la coupe carrée 계열의 각진·사각 헤어컷이고 ‘swnzari’는 sans arrêt, 즉 계속·쉼 없이의 방향이에요. 알려진 방향을 모두 불투명하게 두지 않아요. canonical 표면: `ia 3ndki hadi kiraha mshawjia baldhb 7ta zhrha 3waj . krim arwa7 hna . khwia raha 6 t3 sba7 shd krim ta3k , khima ndlih lk mn alta9a . wi alzin lakwb kari w nkhmm fik swnzari .`.

latin: fi sma w ma slknash m3akm . allh i7fz w istr . khti baghi ns9sik m3lish . sha hw ? tiara hadi mti7sh . shft rwbwrtaj fi nasiwnal jiw9raf twswst . win t7si . 3lmi 3lmk khwia m3labalish 7ta bilwt w rah mtlms . bl3wa biban rw7 jm3 khwia rw7 w ma tnsash shhada h .
english: ‘3lmi 3lmk’ is ‘I know as much as you/I don’t know either’; ‘7ta bilwt w rah mtlms’ says even the pilot is lost/confused; ‘bl3wa biban’ directly says close the doors. Only ‘twswst’ and ‘win t7si’ remain source-close if uncertain. Canonical surface: `fi sma w ma slknash m3akm . allh i7fz w istr . khti baghi ns9sik m3lish . sha hw ? tiara hadi mti7sh . shft rwbwrtaj fi nasiwnal jiw9raf twswst . win t7si . 3lmi 3lmk khwia m3labalish 7ta bilwt w rah mtlms . bl3wa biban rw7 jm3 khwia rw7 w ma tnsash shhada h .`.
korean: ‘3lmi 3lmk’는 ‘나도 너만큼 알아/나도 몰라’이고, ‘7ta bilwt w rah mtlms’는 조종사조차 헤매고 있다는 뜻이에요. ‘bl3wa biban’은 문을 닫으라고 직접 번역해요. 불확실한 ‘twswst’와 ‘win t7si’만 원문에 가깝게 남겨요. canonical 표면: `fi sma w ma slknash m3akm . allh i7fz w istr . khti baghi ns9sik m3lish . sha hw ? tiara hadi mti7sh . shft rwbwrtaj fi nasiwnal jiw9raf twswst . win t7si . 3lmi 3lmk khwia m3labalish 7ta bilwt w rah mtlms . bl3wa biban rw7 jm3 khwia rw7 w ma tnsash shhada h .`.

latin: al3aila aljzairia al3zima ki tkwn ttfrj almatsh hdik li 7asba rw7ha f 2010 .
english: The speaker describes the great Algerian family watching the match and jokes about someone who thinks they are still in 2010.
korean: 화자는 위대한 알제리 가족이 경기를 보는 모습을 말하고 누군가가 아직도 2010년에 있다고 생각한다고 농담해요.

latin: ziani s9inw7 win rah ?
english: The speaker asks where Ziani is; the named footballer reference is kept without adding context.
korean: 화자는 지아니가 어디 있는지 물어요. 축구 선수 이름이라는 표면은 추가 맥락 없이 보존해요.

latin: raki 7asba rw7k f 2010 ma b9ash ziani ia 3mri ma i9dwsh ijibwh il3b ghir matsh haka . tw7shth .
english: The speaker addresses ‘ia 3mri’, asks rhetorically whether they cannot bring Ziani to play even one match, and ends ‘tw7shth’—‘I miss him/he is missed’. The address and missing statement are direct content. Canonical surface: `raki 7asba rw7k f 2010 ma b9ash ziani ia 3mri ma i9dwsh ijibwh il3b ghir matsh haka . tw7shth .`.
korean: 화자는 ‘ia 3mri’라고 부르고 지아니를 한 경기라도 뛰게 데려올 수 없느냐고 수사적으로 물은 뒤 ‘tw7shth’—‘그가 그리워’—로 끝내요. 호칭과 그리움을 직접 번역해요. canonical 표면: `raki 7asba rw7k f 2010 ma b9ash ziani ia 3mri ma i9dwsh ijibwh il3b ghir matsh haka . tw7shth .`.

latin: kr3in m3iz dir lh tibw kima haka mrki kwn rani ana kwn rani mrkit 7 .
english: The speaker jokes about goat legs, says to make him a tifo like this, and says that if the speaker were the one scoring, they would have scored seven; the football joke is source-close.
korean: 화자는 염소 다리라고 놀리며 그를 이런 식으로 응원 깃발로 만들라고 해요. 자신이 득점한 사람이라면 7골을 넣었을 거라고 농담해요.

latin: hadik alli jaia tk7l , ia ki shab wa7d kifah w mnzidsh . rah dair tatwwaj , tb3h .
english: The speaker says the woman is coming to apply kohl, exclaims ‘wow, how handsome he became—I won’t say more’ in ‘ki shab wa7d kifah w mnzidsh’, keeps the tattoo, and says ‘tb3h’—follow him. Canonical surface: `hadik alli jaia tk7l , ia ki shab wa7d kifah w mnzidsh . rah dair tatwwaj , tb3h .`.
korean: 화자는 아이라인을 하러 오는 여성을 말하고 ‘와, 얼마나 멋져졌는지—더 말 안 할게’라는 ‘ki shab wa7d kifah w mnzidsh’ 감탄을 해요. 문신을 말하고 ‘tb3h’로 그를 따라가라고 해요. canonical 표면: `hadik alli jaia tk7l , ia ki shab wa7d kifah w mnzidsh . rah dair tatwwaj , tb3h .`.

latin: li itfrj 9lb w rb . rw7 ia iwnja7 rw7 . 3lah dirwli kima hak . 3lah rahm il3bwa z3ma kwb afrik di mwnd . bl3i fmk allh i7fzk kwn ghir hdrtk fiha faida 7mara .
english: The speaker keeps the direct insult: ‘if only your words had some use, you donkey’ in ‘kwn ghir hdrtk fiha faida 7mara’, together with the opening and named/opaque ‘iwnja7’. ‘7mara’ is translated as the insult, not as metadata. Canonical surface: `li itfrj 9lb w rb . rw7 ia iwnja7 rw7 . 3lah dirwli kima hak . 3lah rahm il3bwa z3ma kwb afrik di mwnd . bl3i fmk allh i7fzk kwn ghir hdrtk fiha faida 7mara .`.
korean: 화자는 ‘네 말에 쓸모라도 있었으면 좋겠네, 이 당나귀야’라는 ‘kwn ghir hdrtk fiha faida 7mara’ 직접 욕설을 보존해요. ‘iwnja7’ 표면과 초두도 유지하고 ‘7mara’를 메타데이터로 처리하지 않아요. canonical 표면: `li itfrj 9lb w rb . rw7 ia iwnja7 rw7 . 3lah dirwli kima hak . 3lah rahm il3bwa z3ma kwb afrik di mwnd . bl3i fmk allh i7fzk kwn ghir hdrtk fiha faida 7mara .`.

latin: wah hwma irb7wa fdrahm w ntwma 93dwa madbzin li 3lihm hna . nwdi nti n9ili btata , 9a3dtli mjm3a li m3 traris .
english: The speaker says the others make money while the listeners argue about them, tells the woman to get up and clean potatoes, and says she is gathered with the guys/men in ‘9a3dtli mjm3a li m3 traris’. ‘traris’ is translated toward guys, not erased as an opaque group. Canonical surface: `wah hwma irb7wa fdrahm w ntwma 93dwa madbzin li 3lihm hna . nwdi nti n9ili btata , 9a3dtli mjm3a li m3 traris .`.
korean: 화자는 다른 사람들이 돈을 버는데 일행은 그들 때문에 다툰다고 말하고, 여성에게 일어나 감자를 손질하라고 해요. ‘9a3dtli mjm3a li m3 traris’는 그녀가 남자들·녀석들과 모여 있다는 직접적인 비난으로, ‘traris’를 막연한 그룹으로 지우지 않아요. canonical 표면: `wah hwma irb7wa fdrahm w ntwma 93dwa madbzin li 3lihm hna . nwdi nti n9ili btata , 9a3dtli mjm3a li m3 traris .`.

latin: nb3 al7nan ki tkhrj tshri m3 bntha : 3am bash tkhrji li 3rwsa nti . ana nlbs sbati w nkhrj ma n9ar3sh . khatsh ndir 3lik ntia 7ta al3sha' ndkhl ldari . baghi 7ta i9wlwa manish 3arfa win kant haima hi w bntha fi ns liali . mama ndi hadi w la hadi .
english: ‘ma n9ar3sh’ is ‘I do not wait’, not ‘I do not argue’. The late-night clause asks whether the speaker is meant to hear people say where the mother and daughter had been wandering in the middle of the night; that accusation is translated directly. Canonical surface: `nb3 al7nan ki tkhrj tshri m3 bntha : 3am bash tkhrji li 3rwsa nti . ana nlbs sbati w nkhrj ma n9ar3sh . khatsh ndir 3lik ntia 7ta al3sha' ndkhl ldari . baghi 7ta i9wlwa manish 3arfa win kant haima hi w bntha fi ns liali . mama ndi hadi w la hadi .`.
korean: ‘ma n9ar3sh’는 ‘나는 기다리지 않아’이지 ‘다투지 않아’가 아니에요. 밤중 절은 엄마와 딸이 한밤중에 어디를 돌아다녔는지 사람들이 말하는 것을 자신이 듣게 하려는 것이냐는 비난으로 직접 번역해요. canonical 표면: `nb3 al7nan ki tkhrj tshri m3 bntha : 3am bash tkhrji li 3rwsa nti . ana nlbs sbati w nkhrj ma n9ar3sh . khatsh ndir 3lik ntia 7ta al3sha' ndkhl ldari . baghi 7ta i9wlwa manish 3arfa win kant haima hi w bntha fi ns liali . mama ndi hadi w la hadi .`.

latin: jaia tbghi al7rir w li ib9s
english: The speaker says she is coming wanting silk and mentions the one who cuts it; the short line is incomplete and the action is source-ambiguous.
korean: 화자는 비단을 원하며 오고 있고 그것을 자르는 사람을 언급해요. 짧은 문장이라 행동은 불투명하고 불완전해요.

latin: kwn n9wlk tdi hadi tdiha ma n3rfksh rask khshin . dbr rask . ana 3jbtni hadi . w 3lah ma tdish lkhra mstwra baghi trw7i t3ri li fi aljam3a hak rbitk ana .
english: The addressee is the woman who wants to go and expose herself at the university in ‘baghi trw7i t3ri li fi aljam3a’; no speaker or third woman is invented as the exposed object. Canonical surface: `kwn n9wlk tdi hadi tdiha ma n3rfksh rask khshin . dbr rask . ana 3jbtni hadi . w 3lah ma tdish lkhra mstwra baghi trw7i t3ri li fi aljam3a hak rbitk ana .`.
korean: ‘baghi trw7i t3ri li fi aljam3a’의 방향은 여성 청자가 대학에서 자기 자신을 드러내려 한다는 것이에요. 화자나 제3의 여성을 노출 대상이라고 창작하지 않아요. canonical 표면: `kwn n9wlk tdi hadi tdiha ma n3rfksh rask khshin . dbr rask . ana 3jbtni hadi . w 3lah ma tdish lkhra mstwra baghi trw7i t3ri li fi aljam3a hak rbitk ana .`.

latin: 3lik al7md . ana 7sbtk tghashiti dakhl . saii mama ghadi ndi hadi . sh3al dir hadi wldi ? khmsia alf 7aja . 3nd jark dir ghir 200 alf bla m3awda . ia wldi dir m3aha mskina m3ndhash 3ndk 3ndha 50 alf ftzdam . la mama 3ndi bl3i fmk .
english: The amounts are distinct: fifty thousand for the item, two hundred thousand without exchange at the neighbour’s, and fifty thousand in the later plea. The final ‘la mama 3ndi bl3i fmk’ is the speaker saying ‘No, mother, I have money; shut your mouth’, not the mother answering. Canonical surface: `3lik al7md . ana 7sbtk tghashiti dakhl . saii mama ghadi ndi hadi . sh3al dir hadi wldi ? khmsia alf 7aja . 3nd jark dir ghir 200 alf bla m3awda . ia wldi dir m3aha mskina m3ndhash 3ndk 3ndha 50 alf ftzdam . la mama 3ndi bl3i fmk .`.
korean: 금액은 서로 달라요. 물건은 5만, 이웃의 것은 교환 없이 20만, 뒤의 부탁에는 5만이 나와요. 마지막 ‘la mama 3ndi bl3i fmk’는 화자가 ‘아니 엄마, 나 돈 있어. 입 다물어’라고 하는 turn이지 엄마의 대답이 아니에요. canonical 표면: `3lik al7md . ana 7sbtk tghashiti dakhl . saii mama ghadi ndi hadi . sh3al dir hadi wldi ? khmsia alf 7aja . 3nd jark dir ghir 200 alf bla m3awda . ia wldi dir m3aha mskina m3ndhash 3ndk 3ndha 50 alf ftzdam . la mama 3ndi bl3i fmk .`.

latin: aia wldi ntklwa 3la allh 50 alf rbi inj7k . la mimti mafihash . hahw wjhi ada rb7t nwdi khrji 9dami khian .
english: The speakers decide to trust God and mention fifty thousand, wish success, reject the mother’s response, and say ‘here is my face’; if the speaker wins, the other person should leave before them, called a traitor. The exchange is comic and source-close.
korean: 화자들은 신을 믿자고 하며 5만을 언급하고 성공을 빌어요. 엄마의 말을 거부하고 ‘여기 내 얼굴이 있어’라고 하며 자신이 이기면 상대가 자신보다 먼저 나가라고 하고 배신자라고 부르는 코미디 turn이에요.

latin: shwfi ada 3awdt khrjt m3ak ma ntsmash mn sba7 w nti dwri li 3jb w m3jb ma i3jbksh bs7 ana fia lafwt m3lish nstahl .
english: The speaker says that if they go out with the listener again, they will not be named or recognized after the morning, because the listener turns around whatever they like and dislike; the speaker admits having a fault and deserving it.
korean: 화자는 상대와 다시 외출하면 아침부터 자신의 이름을 말할 수 없을 것이라고 해요. 상대가 좋아하는 것과 싫어하는 것을 마음대로 돌린다고 하며 자신에게 잘못이 있고 그럴 만하다고 인정해요.

latin: darna fi al3rdat . aia khfwa jibwna zwj ghraif 7rira sha rakm dirwa mn sba7 shashra rahm i9ar3wa . sha raki daira nti lbsi khmar stri rw7k jaitni kima hak 9dam rjal .
english: ‘aia khfwa’ directly means hurry/come quickly; ‘sha rakm dirwa mn sba7’ is a reproach about what they have done since morning; the final ‘lbsi khmar stri rw7k ... 9dam rjal’ directly tells the woman to wear a khimar and cover herself before men. Only ‘shashra rahm i9ar3wa’ remains opaque. Canonical surface: `darna fi al3rdat . aia khfwa jibwna zwj ghraif 7rira sha rakm dirwa mn sba7 shashra rahm i9ar3wa . sha raki daira nti lbsi khmar stri rw7k jaitni kima hak 9dam rjal .`.
korean: ‘aia khfwa’는 어서·빨리 오라는 말이고, ‘sha rakm dirwa mn sba7’은 아침부터 무엇을 했느냐는 질책이에요. 마지막 ‘lbsi khmar stri rw7k ... 9dam rjal’은 남자들 앞에서 키마르를 쓰고 몸을 가리라는 직접 지시예요. ‘shashra rahm i9ar3wa’만 불투명하게 남겨요. canonical 표면: `darna fi al3rdat . aia khfwa jibwna zwj ghraif 7rira sha rakm dirwa mn sba7 shashra rahm i9ar3wa . sha raki daira nti lbsi khmar stri rw7k jaitni kima hak 9dam rjal .`.

latin: ia khti shir amn rahi iz9i 3lia . khwia nta ghir wld jwarin 9a3d takl fi rw7k . dkhl 7rira a bl3 .
english: ‘rahi iz9i 3lia’ says she is shouting at me; ‘takl fi rw7k’ directly tells the addressee not to eat himself; ‘dkhl 7rira a bl3’ says bring in the harira and eat. Only ‘shir amn’ remains source-close. Canonical surface: `ia khti shir amn rahi iz9i 3lia . khwia nta ghir wld jwarin 9a3d takl fi rw7k . dkhl 7rira a bl3 .`.
korean: ‘rahi iz9i 3lia’는 그녀가 나에게 소리치거나 고함친다는 뜻이고, ‘takl fi rw7k’는 자신을 먹지 말라는 직접 말이에요. ‘dkhl 7rira a bl3’는 하리라를 들여와 먹으라는 말이에요. ‘shir amn’만 원문에 가깝게 둬요. canonical 표면: `ia khti shir amn rahi iz9i 3lia . khwia nta ghir wld jwarin 9a3d takl fi rw7k . dkhl 7rira a bl3 .`.

latin: wldi bit alma win allh i7fz . rah lhiha 7aja kain ma bash nstja . wah ja ghir shwia hak alma 7aja . s7a wldi .
english: ‘bit alma’ is the bathroom/toilet; ‘bash nstja’ is for post-toilet cleansing/istinja. The reply directly says only a little came out—‘here, water…’—before ‘s7a wldi’. Canonical surface: `wldi bit alma win allh i7fz . rah lhiha 7aja kain ma bash nstja . wah ja ghir shwia hak alma 7aja . s7a wldi .`.
korean: ‘bit alma’는 화장실이고 ‘bash nstja’는 용변 후 세정·이스틴자를 위한 말이에요. 응답은 ‘조금밖에 안 나왔어, 여기 물…’이라고 직접 말한 뒤 ‘s7a wldi’로 끝나요. canonical 표면: `wldi bit alma win allh i7fz . rah lhiha 7aja kain ma bash nstja . wah ja ghir shwia hak alma 7aja . s7a wldi .`.

latin: ghadi ndkhl nstnja 7mbwk jbdli srbita t3 kr3in bash nshf kr3ia w ntwda w jibli mfta7 t3 hadik albit alli rakm dasin fiha 9atw nbghi nsli fskat .
english: The speaker says they are going to the bathroom, asks for a towel for their feet so they can dry them and perform ablution, and asks for the key to the room where the cat is hidden because they want to pray quietly.
korean: 화자는 용변을 보러 가며 발을 닦고 세정 의식을 할 수 있도록 발 수건을 달라고 해요. 고양이를 숨겨 둔 방의 열쇠를 달라고 하며 조용히 기도하고 싶다고 해요.

latin: rakm tshwfwa fi hdik shibania alli raha liha . hadik shrira . wah kl 15 d9i9a t9l3 fmha tnfkhh bma . khs ki t9l3h had khtra nrw7wa njrwa ndirw lha hak ndwlha fmha nrdma h ftrab . iadra khta shftha fi mbs 2 .
english: The speaker points out an old woman who is a bad person, says she pulls her mouth and fills it with water every fifteen minutes, and jokes that next time they will run over and bury her mouth in the dirt, referring to a plan seen in MBS2.
korean: 화자는 저기 있는 노년 여성이 못된 사람이라고 말하고 15분마다 입을 당겨 물로 부풀린다고 해요. 다음에는 달려가 그 여성의 입을 흙에 묻겠다고 농담하며 MBS2에서 본 계획을 언급해요.

latin: mama baba ja idik 9alk arwa7i nwslk 9bl ma nwslk lstad hwd 9lh iwli mnb3d jaini drwk had win 7lat aljma3a . ia rajlk ma i9wlk walw . sha rah mdkhlk ntia raki tm3nili bash nrw7 z3ma . hna n93d frshwli rani baita .
english: The father is the singular pickup actor in ‘baba ja idik’; ‘hwd 9lh iwli mnb3d’ keeps ‘go down and tell him to come back later’; ‘had win 7lat aljma3a’ says the gathering has just become lively; and ‘raki tm3nili bash nrw7 z3ma’ asks, ‘are you hinting that I should go?’. Canonical surface: `mama baba ja idik 9alk arwa7i nwslk 9bl ma nwslk lstad hwd 9lh iwli mnb3d jaini drwk had win 7lat aljma3a . ia rajlk ma i9wlk walw . sha rah mdkhlk ntia raki tm3nili bash nrw7 z3ma . hna n93d frshwli rani baita .`.
korean: ‘baba ja idik’에서는 아버지가 단수로 데리러 오는 행위자예요. ‘hwd 9lh iwli mnb3d’는 내려가서 나중에 다시 오라고 하라는 방향이고, ‘had win 7lat aljma3a’는 이제 막 모임이 재미있어졌다는 말이에요. ‘raki tm3nili bash nrw7 z3ma’는 ‘내가 가라고 눈치 주는 거야?’라는 질문이에요. canonical 표면: `mama baba ja idik 9alk arwa7i nwslk 9bl ma nwslk lstad hwd 9lh iwli mnb3d jaini drwk had win 7lat aljma3a . ia rajlk ma i9wlk walw . sha rah mdkhlk ntia raki tm3nili bash nrw7 z3ma . hna n93d frshwli rani baita .`.
